concerns.text: The regression model (FR‑005) predicts the 'collapse intensity' target, which is itself deterministically derived from the same acoustic predictors (SNR, RT60) and the SSS/WER thresholds (FR‑021). This creates a circular validation: the outcome is a function of the inputs, so the regression cannot demonstrate an independent, universal interaction effect but merely learns the predefined algorithm. The target must be independent of the predictors for a scientifically valid test of the hypothesized critical interaction vector.
